metadata.description: Tobias Schlitt's Claude Code plugins: the tce context-engineering workflow, the tmt markdown ticket tracker, and the tle loop-engineering convergence loop.

plugins.name: tce
plugins.description: Context-engineering workflow: ticket → research → plan → implement, plus review/discuss/design commands and research agents. Authors tickets (/tce:ticket) and works with any ticket system (tmt, GitHub, Jira, Linear, …).

plugins.name: tmt
plugins.description: Toby Markdown Tickets: lightweight Git-tracked ticket tracker — tickets as markdown files in your repo, owning the envelope (sequential numbering, status-lifecycle hooks, create/update). tce's native ticket backend.

plugins.name: tle
plugins.description: Toby Loop Engineering: an autonomous convergence loop — define a machine-checkable goal, then iterate verify → spec → implement until every checklist item verifiably passes. Greenfield-first; file-only handoffs under thoughts/shared/loops/.
